rv.q: The production, praised by almost every reviewer for its freshness, moved to the West End, drew the crowds.
Fish and his cast ask reasoned questions of a musical and answer them with vivid, pugnacious confidence.
Fish demands almost as much from the people in the audience as he does from his cast
As with many a reimagining of a classic, not all of Fish's gambits entirely work.
Still, this Oklahoma! deserves credit for out-of-the-box thinking and casting.
